units.source_text: 是夜匂亲王仍请薰君引导赴宇治。

en.t: That night, Prince Niou again asked Kaoru to guide him to Uji.

units.source_text: 但薰君说：“今夜冷泉上皇召我，我非去不可，不能奉陪了。”

en.t: But Kaoru said, "Tonight the retired emperor Reizei has summoned me, and I must go; I cannot accompany you."

units.source_text: 拒绝他的要求。

en.t: In this way he refused the prince's request.

units.source_text: 匂亲王想：“此人的怪癖又发作了。”

en.t: Prince Niou thought, "This man's odd habit has flared up again."

units.source_text: 很讨厌他，也就不再强请。

en.t: He found Kaoru very irritating and therefore did not press him any further.

units.source_text: 宇治的大女公子想：“事已如此，岂可为了这件亲事非出女方本意而冷淡他呢？”

en.t: The elder princess at Uji thought, "Now that matters have come to this, can we really treat him coldly just because this marriage was not the woman's own wish?"

units.source_text: 心肠便软下来。

en.t: Her heart then softened.

units.source_text: 这山庄里设备虽甚简陋，但也按照山乡风味，布置得齐齐整整，等候新婿上门。

en.t: Although the furnishings of the mountain villa were very plain, they arranged everything neatly in a rustic mountain style and waited for the new bridegroom to arrive.

units.source_text: 她想起匂亲王即将跋涉远道而来，觉得这一片诚心实甚可喜。

en.t: When she thought of Prince Niou soon making the long, difficult journey there, she felt that such sincerity was truly pleasing.

units.source_text: 这心情的变更也很奇怪。

en.t: This change in her feelings was strange as well.

units.source_text: 二女公子本人则茫然若失，一任旁人替她打扮，深红色的衣衫上滴满了眼泪。

en.t: The younger princess herself was dazed and helpless, letting others dress her, while tears fell thickly onto her deep crimson robes.

units.source_text: 那个贤明的姐姐也不禁陪她泣下，对她说道：“我明知自己不能长生在世，朝朝暮暮所考虑的，只是你的终身大事。

en.t: Her wise elder sister could not help weeping with her, and said to her, "I know well that I cannot live long in this world, and morning and evening the only thing I think about is your lifelong future.

units.source_text: 这班老侍女在我耳边絮聒不休，都说这是一段美满姻缘。

en.t: These old gentlewomen have been chattering endlessly in my ear, all saying that this is a fine and happy marriage.

units.source_text: 有年纪的人见多识广，想必是懂得事理的。

en.t: Older people have seen and heard much, so surely they understand how things should be.

units.source_text: 阅世不深的我，有时也曾想起：我们两人固执己见，独身到老，恐怕不是办法。

en.t: Even I, inexperienced as I am in the ways of the world, have sometimes thought that if the two of us stubbornly clung to our own views and grew old unmarried, it would probably not do.

units.source_text: 然而像今番那样出其不意，含羞忍耻，悲伤忧恼，实在是意想不到的！

en.t: But for things to happen so unexpectedly this time, forcing you to endure shame, grief, and distress, was truly beyond anything I imagined!

units.source_text: 这定然是世人所谓‘不可逃避的宿缘’了。

en.t: This must surely be what people call an inescapable bond from a former life.

units.source_text: 我的处境真困难啊！

en.t: My position is truly difficult!

units.source_text: 且待你心情稍稍安定，我再把我对此事全不知情的原由告诉你。

en.t: Wait until your feelings have calmed a little, and then I will tell you why I knew absolutely nothing about this matter.

units.source_text: 请你不要恨我！

en.t: Please do not hate me!

units.source_text: 无端恨人是罪过的。”

en.t: To hate someone without cause is a sin."

units.source_text: 她抚摩着妹妹的头发说这番话。

en.t: She said all this while stroking her younger sister's hair.

units.source_text: 妹妹默默不答，她心知姐姐这番话的确出于一片好心，是顾虑她的前程。

en.t: The younger sister remained silent and did not answer, knowing in her heart that her sister's words truly came from kindness and concern for her future.

units.source_text: 然而她作种种思量：将来倘被遗弃，做了世人的笑柄，使得姐姐失望，实在是伤心的。

en.t: Yet she turned over many thoughts: if in the future she were abandoned, became the laughingstock of the world, and disappointed her sister, it would be truly heartbreaking.
